convertibility_reason: Uses two custom indicators (2pbIdeal1MA and 2pbIdeal3MA) via iCustom calls with unknown internal logic, plus an external .mqh include (TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for order management. Custom indicator logic cannot be auto-converted without reimplementing the indicator calculations in Python.

derived_values.name: Ma1 - 2pbIdeal1MA buffer 0 value
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(InpInd1_Handle, 0, SignalBar, 2) → Ma1[0]=current bar, Ma1[1]=previous bar

derived_values.name: Ma2 - 2pbIdeal3MA buffer 0 value
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(InpInd2_Handle, 0, SignalBar, 2) → Ma2[0]=current bar, Ma2[1]=previous bar

other_exits: Opposite crossover signal closes existing position: Ma1<Ma2 on previous bar triggers close of short; Ma1>Ma2 on previous bar triggers close of long

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM<0 → fixed lot size = abs(MM); MM>0 → deposit fraction = MM

custom_logic_notes: Dual custom MA crossover system: 2pbIdeal1MA (single ideal MA with rough+adjusting smoothing) crossed against 2pbIdeal3MA (triple ideal MA with three rough+adjusting smoothing pairs). Signal logic: BUY when Ma1[1]>Ma2[1] (previous bar: 1MA above 3MA) AND Ma1[0]<Ma2[0] (current bar: 1MA was below 3MA = crossover upward). SELL when Ma1[1]<Ma2[1] AND Ma1[0]>Ma2[0] (crossover downward). The crossover detection uses previous bar comparison for direction and current bar for confirmation. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans gate each direction independently. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions with position-exists checks built in.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement both 2pbIdeal1MA and 2pbIdeal3MA indicator logic in Python. The '2pbIdealMA' family appears to use a two-pass smoothing technique (rough + adjusting). Without the indicator source code, will need to locate the .mq5 source for 2pbIdeal1MA and 2pbIdeal3MA to port their calculation. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen etc.) handle position-exists checks, lot sizing, SL/TP setting — these map to standard backtester order calls. The crossover logic itself is straightforward once indicator values are available. Signal is evaluated on new bar only; use next-bar-open fill assumption. StopLoss=1000 points, TakeProfit=2000 points (with 5-digit broker: 100 pips SL, 200 pips TP). MM=-0.1 means fixed 0.1 lot sizing.
